messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT PAGER -> HIGH - AurumBank (tenant_id=aurumbank) in dedicated pool pool-09: no traces for last 10m, p95 inference latency spike, customers reporting UI timeouts. Paging oncall SRE. /incident create 2790012345 :eyes:

maria (oncall): Acked. I'm oncall for the next 45m. Can someone grab the initial triage? Is this confined to AurumBank or cross-tenant?

devin (platform): Looks scoped to AurumBank in pool-09. Metrics show logs arriving but trace spans count = 0 for that tenant. Logging forwarder shows 403 on write to observability-collector for tenant aurumbank.

raj (eng-runtime): Repro from runtime -> KV cache ok, model responses still served for other tenants on same pool, so compute path is healthy. This smells like the forwarder role/key expired or a routing ACL change in VPC.

jess (sre): @devin can you paste the forwarder error?

devin (platform): Sure: ```2026-03-15T14:12:03Z forwarder[pool-09] ERROR writer.go:87 write failed: Post "https://obs-collector.internal/v1/spans": 403 Forbidden - role "obs-forwarder-aurumbank" invalid/expired (token=expired)```

maria (oncall): :grimacing: ok. @sam (cust-success) can you ping AurumBank engineering to let them know we're working on limited observability? They might see empty traces in their UI. Also want to confirm any local changes.

sam (cust-success): Reached out via email + pagerduty. They say no changes on their end and engineering is available if we need to handshake a rekey.

raj (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation plan: 1) grant temporary forwarding role to pool instance role so spans resume 2) enable best-effort proxy-forwarding to central collector from backup forwarder 3) if needed, replay buffered logs to reconstruct spans.

jess (sre): I can do step 1. Suggest we rotate the obs-forwarder key, but we need a quick grant now. I'm going to run an IAM patch to reattach policy to ec2-role:pool-09-forwarder-ec2-role.

ops-bot: Running playbook: observability-forwarder-rotate v1.3 -> started by jess at 2026-03-15T14:16:10Z

jess (sre): Command I ran: ```aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name pool-09-forwarder-ec2-role --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/obs-forwarder-write``` patch applied, waiting for token propagation (TTL ~30s).

devin (platform): After attach: forwarder logs show 200s for spans POSTs. Spans progressing from 0 -> 1200 in next minute. Sampling looks normal.

maria (oncall): Great. Any gaps in historical traces for the 10m window? Can we replay?

raj (eng-runtime): We have buffered WAL on the forwarder nodes. Replay requires a short maintenance window to avoid duplicate IDs; I'll run a scoped replay to obs-collector with dedup header. Request approval for a 2m slot.

sam (cust-success): AurumBank approves a replay, they want timestamps intact.

jess (sre): Starting replay from buffer shard b-03 -> issuing request: ```curl -X POST "https://obs-collector.internal/v1/replay" -H "X-Dedup: true" -d @b-03-replay.json``` logs show successful ack: 202 Accepted.

devin (platform): After replay metrics: spans_replayed=1188, duplicates=0, spans_ingested=1188. UI timelines for AurumBank start to fill back in. Latency errors subsided.

maria (oncall): Customer impact assessment: Observability gap duration ~ 10m (14:10-14:20Z). Inference p95 spike coincided with missing spans; servicing for customer traffic degraded to increased tail latency but no request failures. We should flag this as SEV3 (observability-only) with possible business impact (customer saw slower UI).

raj (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: obs-forwarder role token rotation didn't complete during automated keyroll; pool-09 forwarder lost write permission temporarily. Follow-ups: 1) add alert for forwarder 4xx/5xx error rate 2) add automated failover to backup forwarder endpoint 3) extend token pre-rotation healthcheck.

jess (sre): I'll file postmortem and runbook updates. Also expanding cluster-level read for buffered spans to accelerate replay without manual approve in the future (needs product sign-off).

sam (cust-success): Noted, told AurumBank we'll follow up with timeline and remediation plan. They asked for a weekly summary once root cause analysis done.

maria (oncall): Closing loop: monitoring shows steady state for 20m, no further regressions. I'll hand this to the weekday oncall for full RCA. Thanks everyone. :tada:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE 2790012345 -> status: mitigated; severity: SEV3; impact_window: 2026-03-15T14:10:00Z - 2026-03-15T14:20:00Z; owner: maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): Adding quick checklist for post-incident: - confirm automated keyroll logs for pool-09 - add forwarder 4xx alert - schedule runbook review with runtime team - send customer-facing timeline to AurumBank PR contact (sam)

raj (eng-runtime): I'll take runbook and automations. jess, can you attach logs and the replay output to the PM?

jess (sre): Done, uploaded to /incidents/2790012345/artifacts (replay-output.log, forwarder-attach.log, forwarder-err-sample.log)

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Handing off to weekday oncall for RCA tracking. :handshake:
